This '''Nysillin farm''' was a [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] farm located on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. It was captured by the [[Nuro pirates/Legends|Nuro Pirates]], who were supplying the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with nysillin during the [[Third battle of Felucia]]. During the battle, the famed [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] commissioned a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to defeat [[Yorn Nuro]], the leader of the Nuro Pirates. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carg]] of [[Graul Company]] also ordered the Jedi Knight to eliminate some of the Nuro Pirates around the farm.
